dedupe_keys.name: streamflow drought hazard indicators for monitoring drought risk for human water supply and river ecosystems at the global scale

description: Claudia Herbert and Petra Döll publish streamflow drought indicators computed with WaterGAP 2.2d and WFDEI-GPCC climate forcing. Coverage is global except Antarctica, on a 0.5-degree grid with monthly values for 1986–2015. The June 2022 deposit provides text files and ZIP archives free under CC BY 4.0. Products include drought magnitude and severity indicators, grid-cell coordinates, mean monthly surface-water abstractions in cubic kilometres per month, and observation-based comparisons at two named stations. Additional files support correlations at 218 of 220 GRDC stations with continuous records. These indicators can supply drought-exposure scenarios or reference conditions for water-supply simulations. They combine model outputs and gauged observations, which must remain distinct. Half-degree monthly data cannot resolve local supply-network interruptions, and detailed indicator thresholds require checking the documentation. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this indicator collection. The numerical files were not downloaded.
